sources.title: eVISA Online Services
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, The Bahamas
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry of Foreign Affairs Consular Division page, updated 1 April 2026, publishes current visa-needed and visa-free country lists plus the Electronic Entry Visa process and timing. It names Sudan, but not South Sudan.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The standard processing time for an eVISA is 7-10 business days

sources.title: List of Countries - Visa Required
sources.publisher: Cayman Islands Customs and Border Control
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Cayman Islands Customs and Border Control table labels countries visa-required or visa-not-required. It contains Sudan and no distinct South Sudan row.

sources.title: Visitor Visa Applications
sources.publisher: Cayman Islands Customs and Border Control
sources.officialityEvidence: The live territorial Customs and Border Control page says persons requiring a visitor visa apply online and states the ordinary processing interval, without assigning South Sudan to that visa-required cohort.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Seven to ten working days after the application has been submitted to the Cayman Islands Visa Office.

unresolved.reason: Not established: the live Bahamas Ministry of Foreign Affairs visa-needed and visa-free lists name Sudan but not South Sudan. Although its EEV service states generic processing time, it does not map a South Sudan ordinary passport to visa need or electronic issuance; no omission, portal, third-country-document or other conditional route is transferred.

Not established: the current Cayman Customs and Border Control table names Sudan but does not include South Sudan. Its generic online visitor-visa page gives seven-to-ten-working-day processing only after determining a person requires a visa; no direct South Sudan ordinary-passport mapping or issuance timing is established from omission.
